description: Rows of one compliance list (address, ZIP, dates, status, the agency's id, a link to the original, and other lists the same address is on). The first 10 rows are free; more cost credits per 100 rows (see get_store). Filter by zip, address (q), status, type, since (YYYY-MM-DD) or stacked=true (addresses on more than one list).

q.description: An address or part of one.

since.description: Only rows dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_compliance_items
title: Get rows of a compliance list
